title: review follow-ups of PR #37595: os init field placement dialect, and the 18.6.0 callouts to remove at 19.0
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4czzx9dtSEm3jWWL9c3

Filing gate: owed follow-ups of landed review work (L1/L2 exception: one `review follow-ups of PR #N` card per PR, items ticked). Source: fleet. Found in the L1 read of PR #37595 (card #37503).

Grading: area:build · Task · stale or inconsistent shipped text for newcomers, no wrong behaviour → suggested p3 · evidence: read on main.

## Items

- [ ] **`os init -t app` still places fields with a per-field `group`.** `packages/cli/src/commands/init.ts` ~1071-1094 on main writes `fieldGroups` plus `group: 'details'` on each field. After PR #37595, `os g object` and the `npm create objectstack` starter (blank template `company.object.ts` / `contact.object.ts`, `examples/app-starter`) all place fields through the group's `fields` list. #32153's promise is that a newcomer meets one dialect, and the CLI still writes two. Both spellings are valid, so this is style, not a defect. Re-check: `git grep -n "group: 'details'" -- packages/cli/src`.
- [ ] **Remove the "18.6.0 today" callouts when 19.0 ships.** PR #37595 adds one callout each to `content/docs/getting-started/your-first-project.mdx` and `content/docs/getting-started/build-with-claude-code.mdx`: "`npm create objectstack@latest` installs `create-objectstack` 18.6.0 today … ships with 19.0". The sentence turns false on the 19.0 GA release. Restart-when: `npm view create-objectstack dist-tags.latest` answers 19.x. Re-check: `git grep -n "18.6.0 today" -- content/docs`.

## Business reason

New builders and coding agents copy the first file they read. The scaffolds and getting-started pages should teach one placement style, and should not tell a reader a version fact that is no longer true.

## Who acts

The seat that owns `area:build` CLI and getting-started docs (today area o1-A of repo:objectstack#1). Item 2 waits for the 19.0 release.

Dedupe: `review follow-ups of PR #37595` → 0 open; `"group: 'details'" init` → 1 hit (#37503, which covers `os g object` only and closes with PR #37595); `o1-A loose ends` → 0.

Parent: objectstack-ai/objectstack#37503.
